title: Dilution keeps the moles, spreads the volume
caption: Adding water doubles the volume but adds no solute. The eight solute particles are now spread through twice the volume, so the concentration halves: c₁V₁ = c₂V₂.
alt: Left: a beaker half full with eight solute particles. Right: the beaker full to twice the volume, still eight particles.
description: Before: 8 solute particles in volume V.
After adding water: the same 8 particles in volume 2V, half the concentration.
